title: The Carriage Where It Always Rains

shots.visual_event: Door Two opens into a flooded railway carriage under indoor thunderclouds; schoolboy Dev clings to a luggage rack above black water.
shots.dialogue_audio: Dev: “Please—I can’t remember my mother’s face.”

shots.visual_event: Saira ties her compass cord around Arin as he wades into rising water; rain falls upward around the exit.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “The door wants a memory, not a hero.”

shots.visual_event: Arin reaches Dev while a warm vision of his mother singing appears in the water beneath him.
Arin closes his eyes and pulls Dev free; the song collapses into silent golden droplets leaving his head.
On Platform 13, Meera tries to hum their mother’s lullaby but both she and Maya suddenly lose the melody.
Dev escapes into a safe compartment; Arin remembers his mother’s face but no longer her voice. Saira sees the cost in him.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “You didn’t pay alone. Your whole city did.”
